name: safety-run-mascot-pixel
style: pixel art (stubby proportions), adapted from the 16x32 character template; exact vector export included
view: From behind, like the game camera.
howToUse: PNG strips: horizontal, frame size = cell, left to right. Place the sprite so `anchor` (the feet, bottom centre) sits on the ground point and scale by u_px / unit; use NEAREST filtering. svg/ and vector.json are the same frames as exact vectors and can be drawn at any size. Squash, stretch and cape/arm motion are drawn into the frames.

idle.note: Breathing; head timing from the template back-view idle (cols 16-19), halved. Plays twice with the cape hem shifting.

run.note: 6-frame loop = two steps, driven by the template back-view walk (head bob and foot lift scaled to this short body). Frames 0-2 = left step, 3-5 = right step.

jump.note: takeoff/rise while vy > 0, apex near 0, fall while vy < 0 (hold the last fall frame), land plays on touchdown. Squash and stretch are drawn in.

slide.note: Slides under low pipes (0.7 s): drop, hold (loop frames 2-5 if the slide lasts longer), recover.
